name: San Fernando Valley Audubon Society Grants
summary: Grants of up to $5,000 from a California Audubon chapter to non-profits (and possibly individuals) for projects that conserve or restore wildlife habitat and biodiversity in its territory.

geography.label: San Fernando Valley Audubon Society territory, California

amount.note: Larger amounts may be considered with prior permission

reporting: A written report of 200-500 words summarising how the funds were used, on project completion.

calls.label: Standing call, proposals before each board meeting

status.quote: is offering grants for projects which advance these goals.

applicant_types.quote: Non-profit groups, including schools, in the SFVAS territory are eligible for SFVAS grants. Grants to individuals may be considered.

access.quote: Applications must be received 4 weeks prior to the next scheduled SFVAS board meeting for possible consideration at that meeting.

amount.quote: Grants of up to $5000 will be considered for projects in the San Fernando Valley Audubon Society Territory.

reporting.quote: Upon project completion, recipients will prepare a written report of 200-500 words and submit it to SFVAS
